guidelines.expectation: All sampled content and error responses have a nonempty document language, one H1 and one main landmark. Attribute presence is not full semantic correctness.

judgments.rationale: Six sampled successful pages have nonempty language, one H1 and one main. The deliberate 404 has lang="" despite one H1 and one main; all sampled responses are required to satisfy the narrow check.
judgments.nextEvidence: Capture the deliberate missing path after setting an appropriate nonempty document language; separately review translation correctness.

guidelines.title: Defer the loading of non-critical resources
guidelines.expectation: Sampled non-critical media is deferred until relevant intent, or necessary eager loading is justified. Unknown screenshot utility or rendition prerequisites can leave this unresolved.

judgments.rationale: All four instructional screenshots are already complete below the initial viewport and are fetched before scrolling. This establishes eager loading, but the evidence does not settle whether these instructional media are non-critical or whether eager loading is justified. Their 900-pixel rendition alone is insufficient to prescribe a smaller replacement.
judgments.nextEvidence: Assess screenshot legibility and instructional relevance at target device pixel densities; then test whether deferral preserves the reading task and when requests start.

guidelines.expectation: Published footprint figures are attributable to a clear population and units and reconcile arithmetically. Missing site-specific attribution remains unresolved.

judgments.rationale: Supplied disclosures describe an ecosystem population of 6,431 Wagtail sites, not an attributable guide.wagtail.org footprint. Their stated 5,173 tonnes/year divided by 6,431 is about 0.804 tonnes/site/year, inconsistent with the stated 12; this ecosystem contradiction is not a demonstrated guide-specific figure defect. Site-specific attribution remains unresolved.
judgments.nextEvidence: Obtain an explicitly attributed guide.wagtail.org figure with period, units, traffic/page-mix assumptions and arithmetic; clarify the ecosystem average independently.
